units.function: Focused filesystem tests for lossless extension-key updates, semantic no-op writes and durable invalid-config backup plus atomic repair.
units.dependencyDirection: Calls production config store/schema directly against cleaned temporary roots and spies on filesystem durability primitives.
units.keyDataModels: Typed Paperclip config with unknown extensions, metadata source/timestamp, invalid raw bytes, collision-safe backup path and atomic temp path.
units.lifecycle: Reads and merges known fields, skips semantic no-op, fsyncs backup and directory, refuses unauthorized overwrite, atomically renames repaired config and removes staging files.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 3/3. Durability ordering and byte preservation are strong; permissions/ownership, symlinks, concurrent versions, disk failures, backup lifecycle/encryption, Secret redaction and extension ownership remain absent.
units.designRationale: Preserve forward/plugin configuration across upgrades and make recovery from malformed JSON explicit and crash-resistant.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs safe config evolution across managed-cloud/self-hosted profiles without destroying enterprise extensions or Secrets.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT closely: preserve namespaced extensions, semantic no-op and backup+fsync+atomic rename. Add extension schema/owner provenance, compare-and-swap generation, 0600/ownership and symlink checks, encrypted/retained backups, failure injection and Secret-safe errors.
units.responsibilityConflict: Configuration durability is compatible, but metadata-only changes are discarded and no accountable change record binds who authorized security-sensitive configuration mutations.

units.function: Fail-closed command tests for unknown sections, missing config and non-interactive malformed-config handling.
units.dependencyDirection: Runs the production configure command against temporary files but does not exercise successful prompts or server deployment.
units.keyDataModels: Config section, exitCode, malformed raw JSON and invalid-byte backup.
units.lifecycle: Rejects unsupported/missing input and backs up malformed bytes without replacing them when confirmation is unavailable.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 3/3. Fail-closed preservation works, but no successful configuration path or policy combination is tested; observed output includes the parser excerpt of malformed original bytes, creating a Secret-log risk.
units.designRationale: Prevent unattended repair from silently destroying operator configuration.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs safe deployment-profile changes and diagnostics that never leak identity, database or Connector Secrets.
units.companyOsFit: REJECT the current error-output contract because malformed config excerpts can expose Secrets. Keep the fail-closed backup behavior, but emit stable redacted codes, show a structured security diff for successful changes and validate deployment/auth/storage/Secret invariants before an accountable apply.
units.responsibilityConflict: A process exit code and backup path do not record who approved a security-policy change; successful configuration must create an accountable change/evidence record.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 3 passed; console output exposed malformed JSON parser excerpt

units.function: Interactive test for confirmed, backed-up and atomically committed repair of an invalid config from defaults.
units.dependencyDirection: Runs configure with prompt/server modules mocked, checks the production store output and atomic rename, and restores TTY globals.
units.keyDataModels: Invalid raw bytes, numbered backup, default-false confirmation and staged config path.
units.lifecycle: Detects invalid config, backs it up, asks confirmation, stages defaults and atomically replaces the original.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 1/1. Confirmation and atomic commit work, but actual field repair, decline/cancel, diff, validation/failure rollback, concurrency and identity/Secret rebinding are untested.
units.designRationale: Provide an operator recovery path while preserving the exact broken input.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs recoverable local-enterprise configuration repair without silently changing authentication, data or execution boundaries.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the default-false prompt, exact backup and staged validation/rename. Require a redacted before/after risk diff, preserve salvageable namespaced config, rebind Secrets/identity explicitly, support rollback/failure injection and record accountable approval.
units.responsibilityConflict: Repair from defaults is potentially a security-boundary change, yet the confirmation is not bound to an identified human, exact diff/digest or durable audit evidence.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 1 passed in combined 7-test run
